extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於薪資、收費與時刻表情境，如 hourly wage、hourly rate。可放在名詞前當形容詞，也可放在動詞後當副詞。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hourly 字尾雖是 -ly，但可當形容詞（an hourly rate）也可當副詞（paid hourly）。

example.en: Our lawyer's hourly rate is higher than we expected.
example.zh: 我們律師的每小時費率比我們預期的高。

example.en: The company raised the hourly wage for new staff.
example.zh: 公司調高了新進員工的時薪。

example.en: Temporary workers are paid on an hourly basis.
example.zh: 臨時工是按小時計酬。

examples.en: Hourly buses run between the airport and the hotel.
examples.zh: 每小時一班的巴士往返機場與飯店。

examples.en: The consultant charges an hourly fee for each meeting.
examples.zh: 顧問每場會議按小時收費。

examples.en: The system saves the data hourly to protect all files.
examples.zh: 系統每小時儲存一次資料，以保護所有檔案。

similar.diff: per hour 是片語，放在金額或數量後面；hourly 是單字，可放在名詞前。

example.en: The workers earn fifteen dollars per hour.
example.zh: 工人每小時賺十五美元。

example.en: Please send me a daily report by five.
example.zh: 請在五點前寄給我每日報告。

example.en: We hold a weekly meeting on Monday mornings.
example.zh: 我們每週一早上開週會。

example.en: The monthly fee includes internet and phone service.
example.zh: 月費包含網路和電話服務。

derived.link: 最基本的字；hour + -ly，每…的，像 daily、weekly、monthly

example.en: Hourly updates will be posted on the company website.
example.zh: 每小時的更新會張貼在公司網站上。

example.en: Most of the temporary staff are paid hourly, not monthly.
example.zh: 大部分臨時員工是按小時計酬，不是按月。

extra_vocab.en: the machines and parts of a computer, or tools made of metal
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於 IT 與採購情境，指電腦的實體設備，和 software 相對。在店面情境中，hardware store 指五金行。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: hardware 是不可數名詞，不加 s，不說 a hardware；要計算時用 a piece of hardware。

example.en: The company sells computer hardware to schools and offices.
example.zh: 這家公司把電腦硬體賣給學校和辦公室。

example.en: There is a hardware store next to the post office.
example.zh: 郵局旁邊有一家五金行。

example.en: Both hardware and software must be updated each year.
example.zh: 硬體和軟體每年都必須更新。

examples.en: We need to upgrade our hardware before installing the new system.
examples.zh: 安裝新系統之前，我們需要先升級硬體。

examples.en: The hardware costs more than the software license.
examples.zh: 硬體的費用比軟體授權費高。

examples.en: The technician found a problem with the hardware, not the program.
examples.zh: 技師發現問題出在硬體，而不是程式。

confusable.diff: 意思相反：hardware 是看得到、摸得到的設備；software 是電腦裡的程式。

example.en: The new software runs faster on the updated computer.
example.zh: 新的軟體在更新後的電腦上跑得更快。

similar.diff: equipment 泛指各種設備；hardware 特指電腦硬體或五金用品。

example.en: The factory bought new equipment for packing.
example.zh: 工廠買了新的包裝設備。

example.en: Please charge your device before the meeting.
example.zh: 開會前請先替你的裝置充電。

example.en: All office equipment must be checked every year.
example.zh: 所有辦公設備每年都必須檢查。

example.en: This tool makes the repair work much easier.
example.zh: 這個工具讓維修工作容易許多。

senses.en: the machines and parts of a computer system
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 software、computer、upgrade、system 等字時，指電腦硬體。

example.en: The hardware in our office is more than five years old.
example.zh: 我們辦公室的硬體已經用了五年以上。

senses.en: tools and small metal things used at home or at work
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 store、shop、tools、nails 等字時，指五金用品。

example.en: The shop sells paint, tools, and other hardware for repairs.
example.zh: 這家店販售油漆、工具和其他維修用的五金。

extra_vocab.en: something you enjoy doing in your free time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於面試、履歷、公司社團與閒聊情境，指下班後喜歡做的活動。常和 free time、club 一起出現。

example.en: Reading and swimming are two of her favorite hobbies.
example.zh: 閱讀和游泳是她最喜歡的兩項嗜好。

example.en: It is healthy to have a hobby outside of work.
example.zh: 在工作之外有一項嗜好對身心有益。

example.en: She took up a new hobby after she retired.
example.zh: 她退休後開始培養一項新的嗜好。

example.en: Employees can join the hobby club of their choice.
example.zh: 員工可以加入自己喜歡的興趣社團。

examples.en: My hobby is photography, and I take pictures every weekend.
examples.zh: 我的嗜好是攝影，我每個週末都會拍照。

examples.en: Please list your main hobby at the bottom of the form.
examples.zh: 請把你主要的嗜好寫在表格下方。

examples.en: The company supports staff who want to learn a new hobby.
examples.zh: 公司支持想學習新嗜好的員工。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；habit 是不自覺養成的習慣，hobby 是喜歡做的活動。

example.en: Checking email every hour is a habit I need to change.
example.zh: 每小時查看電子郵件是我需要改掉的習慣。

similar.diff: pastime 指打發時間的消遣，較正式；hobby 常指長期投入的興趣。

example.en: Gardening is her favorite pastime after work.
example.zh: 園藝是她下班後最喜歡的消遣。

example.en: He has a strong interest in digital design.
example.zh: 他對數位設計很有興趣。

example.en: The hotel has many leisure activities for guests.
example.zh: 這家飯店為客人提供許多休閒活動。

example.en: I joined the running club at my company.
example.zh: 我加入了公司的跑步社團。

derived.link: hobby + -ist，專門做某事的人，像 artist、scientist

extra_vocab.en: a short period of work for a student to learn job skills
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於徵才、履歷與校園合作情境，指學生或新鮮人在公司短期實習。常和 apply for、paid、summer 一起出現。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: internship 指「實習」這段經歷，人是 intern：do an internship、be an intern，不要混用。

example.en: The firm offers five internships in marketing every year.
example.zh: 這家公司每年提供五個行銷實習機會。

example.en: He found a summer internship at a software company.
example.zh: 他在一家軟體公司找到了暑期實習。

example.en: A paid internship helps students cover their living costs.
example.zh: 有薪實習能幫助學生支付生活費。

example.en: You can apply for an internship through our website.
example.zh: 你可以透過我們的網站申請實習。

example.en: The internship program starts in the first week of July.
example.zh: 實習計畫在七月的第一週開始。

examples.en: She gained useful skills during her internship at a bank.
examples.zh: 她在銀行實習期間學到了實用的技能。

examples.en: The company offers a three-month internship to university students.
examples.zh: 公司提供大學生為期三個月的實習。

examples.en: Applications for the internship close at the end of this month.
examples.zh: 實習的申請在本月底截止。

similar.diff: apprenticeship 是學徒制，重在學技術、時間較長；internship 多為短期實習。

example.en: The apprenticeship lasts two years and includes technical training.
example.zh: 這個學徒制為期兩年，包含技術訓練。

example.en: Each trainee will work with a senior employee.
example.zh: 每位受訓人員都會跟一位資深員工一起工作。

example.en: We are hiring recent graduates for this position.
example.zh: 我們正在為這個職位招募應屆畢業生。

derived.link: 最基本的字；intern + -ship，身分或時期，像 friend → friendship、member → membership

extra_vocab.en: to stop someone or something for a short time
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於會議、電話與服務中斷的情境。可以指打斷別人說話，也可指使工作或服務暫時停止。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: interrupt 是及物動詞，直接接人或事（interrupt the speaker），不加 to；被打斷用 be interrupted by。

example.en: A loud noise interrupts the call every few minutes.
example.zh: 一陣很大的噪音每隔幾分鐘就打斷通話。

example.en: Heavy rain interrupted the outdoor event for an hour.
example.zh: 大雨讓戶外活動中斷了一個小時。

example.en: Stop interrupting me while I explain the new plan.
example.zh: 我在說明新計畫時，請不要再打斷我。

example.en: Sorry to interrupt, but the client is on the phone.
example.zh: 不好意思打斷一下，客戶在電話上。

example.en: Don't interrupt a meeting unless it is an emergency.
example.zh: 除非是緊急情況，否則請不要打斷會議。

example.en: It is rude to interrupt a conversation between two clients.
example.zh: 打斷兩位客戶之間的談話是不禮貌的。

examples.en: Please do not interrupt the speaker during the presentation.
examples.zh: 簡報進行時，請不要打斷講者。

examples.en: Phone calls often interrupt my work in the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午的電話常常打斷我的工作。

examples.en: A power failure may interrupt our online service tonight.
examples.zh: 停電可能會讓我們今晚的線上服務中斷。

confusable.diff: disrupt 是擾亂、使流程無法正常運作；interrupt 是讓進行中的事暫時停下來。

example.en: A strike may disrupt train services across the country.
example.zh: 罷工可能擾亂全國的火車服務。

similar.diff: disturb 是打擾別人的安靜或休息；interrupt 是中斷正在進行的事。

example.en: Please do not disturb guests after ten at night.
example.zh: 晚上十點後請不要打擾其他客人。

similar.diff: cut in 較口語，常指中途插話。

example.en: He cut in while she was explaining the budget.
example.zh: 她在說明預算時，他中途插話了。

example.en: The speaker paused to take a sip of water.
example.zh: 講者暫停了一下，喝了口水。

example.en: Bad weather may delay the flight by two hours.
example.zh: 天氣不好可能讓班機延遲兩小時。

derived.link: interrupt + -ion，動詞變名詞，像 decide → decision
un- + interrupted，沒有被打斷的，像 unfinished、unlimited

extra_vocab.en: the state of not having much experience
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於招聘、績效與培訓情境，說明失誤或不被錄用的原因是經驗不足。語氣中性偏正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: inexperience 是不可數名詞，不加 s；形容詞是 inexperienced（缺乏經驗的）。

example.en: The mistake happened due to inexperience with the new system.
example.zh: 這個錯誤是因為對新系統不熟悉而發生的。

example.en: His inexperience in sales made the first month difficult.
example.zh: 他缺乏業務經驗，讓第一個月很辛苦。

example.en: Good coaching helps new staff overcome inexperience quickly.
example.zh: 好的指導能幫助新進員工很快克服經驗不足。

examples.en: The candidate's inexperience was the main reason we said no.
examples.zh: 這位應徵者缺乏經驗是我們拒絕他的主要原因。

examples.en: The error was caused by inexperience, not carelessness.
examples.zh: 這個錯誤是因為缺乏經驗，而不是粗心。

examples.en: Our training program helps reduce inexperience among new employees.
examples.zh: 我們的訓練計畫能幫助減少新進員工經驗不足的情況。

confusable.diff: 拼法相近；inexpensive 是「不貴的」，和經驗無關。

example.en: The hotel is inexpensive and close to the station.
example.zh: 這家飯店不貴，而且離車站很近。

similar.diff: lack of experience 是較常見、較口語的片語；inexperience 是單一名詞，較正式。

example.en: Lack of experience should not stop you from applying.
example.zh: 缺乏經驗不應該阻止你提出申請。

example.en: Good communication is an important skill in this job.
example.zh: 良好的溝通是這份工作的重要技能。

example.en: New staff receive two weeks of training.
example.zh: 新進員工會接受兩週的訓練。

derived.link: 最基本的字；in- + experience，沒有…，像 inactive、incomplete
in- + experienced，沒有經驗的，像 incorrect、incomplete

extra_vocab.en: not costing a lot of money
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於廣告、住宿、採購與出差情境。是中性、偏正面的「價格不高」，比 cheap 不容易讓人覺得品質差。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: inexpensive 的比較級通常用 more inexpensive 或 less expensive，不寫 inexpensiver。

example.en: She booked an inexpensive hotel near the conference center.
example.zh: 她訂了一間離會議中心很近、價格不貴的飯店。

example.en: Buying used chairs is an inexpensive option for a new startup.
example.zh: 對新創公司來說，買二手椅子是花費不高的選擇。

example.en: The parts are relatively inexpensive and easy to replace.
example.zh: 這些零件相對便宜，而且容易更換。

examples.en: This printer is inexpensive, but the ink costs more.
examples.zh: 這台印表機不貴，但墨水比較貴。

examples.en: Social media is an inexpensive way to reach customers.
examples.zh: 社群媒體是接觸顧客的低成本方式。

examples.en: Many inexpensive restaurants are located near our office.
examples.zh: 我們辦公室附近有許多價格不貴的餐廳。

confusable.diff: 意思相反：expensive 是昂貴的，inexpensive 是不貴的。

example.en: The new machine is too expensive for our budget.
example.zh: 這台新機器對我們的預算來說太貴了。

similar.diff: cheap 有時帶有「品質不好」的意味；inexpensive 只是中性地說價格不高。

example.en: The cheap bags broke after only one week.
example.zh: 那些廉價的袋子只用了一週就壞了。

similar.diff: affordable 強調一般人付得起；inexpensive 強調價格本身不高。

example.en: The company offers affordable rates for small businesses.
example.zh: 這家公司為小型企業提供負擔得起的費率。

example.en: The price includes delivery and installation.
example.zh: 這個價格包含運送與安裝。

example.en: We have a small budget for this project.
example.zh: 這個專案的預算不多。

example.en: Members receive a ten percent discount on all items.
example.zh: 會員所有商品都享有九折優惠。

derived.link: 最基本的字；expense + -ive 變成「花錢多的」expensive，像 act → active
inexpensive + -ly，形容詞變副詞，像 quick → quickly

extra_vocab.en: covered with ice, or very cold
extra_vocab.note: 多益常見於天氣預報、交通與航班延誤公告，如 icy roads。也可形容冷淡的態度或眼神，如 an icy look。

example.en: The roads are icier tonight than they were last night.
example.zh: 今晚的路面比昨晚結冰得更嚴重。

example.en: This is the iciest winter our region has had in years.
example.zh: 這是我們地區多年來最冰冷的冬天。

example.en: Please drive slowly because the icy roads are dangerous.
example.zh: 結冰的路面很危險，請放慢車速。

example.en: An icy wind blew across the parking lot all morning.
example.zh: 整個早上都有刺骨的冷風吹過停車場。

example.en: Flights were canceled because of icy conditions at the airport.
example.zh: 由於機場結冰，航班被取消了。

examples.en: Drivers should be careful because the bridge is icy this morning.
examples.zh: 駕駛人今天早上要小心，因為橋面結冰了。

examples.en: The icy weather forced us to close the store early.
examples.zh: 冰冷的天氣迫使我們提早關店。

examples.en: The manager gave him an icy look when he arrived late.
examples.zh: 他遲到時，經理給了他一個冷冰冰的眼神。

confusable.diff: 拼法和發音開頭相近；icon 是螢幕上的圖示，和冰無關。

example.en: Click the icon at the top of the screen to start.
example.zh: 點選螢幕上方的圖示就可以開始。

similar.diff: frozen 是已經結凍；icy 是覆蓋著冰或非常冷。

example.en: The pipes are frozen, so we have no water.
example.zh: 水管結凍了，所以我們沒有水。

similar.diff: freezing 指冷到極點的天氣；icy 還可以指表面有冰。

example.en: It is freezing in the warehouse this morning.
example.zh: 今天早上倉庫裡冷得要命。

example.en: Please add some ice to my drink.
example.zh: 請在我的飲料裡加一些冰塊。

example.en: Heavy snow closed the highway last night.
example.zh: 昨晚的大雪讓公路封閉了。

example.en: Keep the products cold, but do not let them freeze.
example.zh: 請讓產品保持低溫，但不要讓它們結凍。

derived.link: 最基本的字；ice + -y，有…的，像 snow → snowy、rain → rainy
icy 去掉 y 加 -ily，變副詞，像 happy → happily

senses.en: covered with ice, or very cold
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 road、wind、weather、bridge 等字時，指結冰或極冷。

example.en: Icy winds made the outdoor event very uncomfortable.
example.zh: 刺骨的冷風讓戶外活動非常不舒服。

senses.en: not friendly in the way you look or speak
senses.distinguish: 旁邊有 look、voice、reply、stare 等字時，指態度冷淡。

example.en: She gave an icy reply when asked about the delay.
example.zh: 被問到延誤的事時，她冷冰冰地回答。
